pay_performance_pay_006.evidence: Currently we have schools participating in the Teacher Advancement Program (TAP). The application process will include approval by 2/3 secret ballot vote of the faculty... incentives up to $2,000 per teacher, tied to student achievement value-added gains...

pay_performance_pay_007.answer: Teacher evaluations for performance-based pay eligibility are tied to student achievement value-added gains as defined by the State of Ohio, according to a formula designed by the Redesign Committee.
pay_performance_pay_007.evidence: incentives are tied to student achievement value-added gains as defined by the State of Ohio.
